reference.selection: highest closed-form revenue over every method, budget and seed

operators.space: region: each item's zone less the aisles the shared repair keeps (_feasibility.AislePlan.move_box / position_bounds)
operators.GA: initial noise N(0, max(0.15 x side, 0.3 m)) and mutation N(0, max(0.12 x side, 0.2 m)) per axis, side = the side of the item's move box (its zone less the aisle rule), clipped 0.05 m inside that box, i.e. into the region (HeadlessShop._ga_move_boxes)
operators.random_search: zone_sampler: uniform over each item's region
operators.simulated_annealing: zone_neighbor(step_frac=0.25): one item, step uniform in +/- 0.25 x its room in its region
operators.simulated_annealing_k: zone_neighbor(step_frac=0.25, n_move=10): 10 distinct items per move, each as above

design.nesting: the same search seed at every budget: GA and random search runs are prefixes of their longer runs
